scope: Local HTTP/1.x heads and shared streaming body decoder; no body writer, network client, SDK promotion or publication
ownership: Move-only decoder retaining bounded scratch/head/trailer metadata; caller-owned non-overlapping borrowed input/output spans; exact prefix progress; no body-sized allocation
profile_limits: Only fixed-length, chunked, EOF-delimited and absent bodies; Upgrade/Tunnel require explicit handoff
At most one contiguous payload span copied per Push; metadata-only progress supports zero output capacity
Errors write no output during that call; earlier successful body output remains incomplete until Complete; discard connection on any error
Chunk extensions validated and ignored; trailers published separately after completion, never merged with head
Known framing/routing/control/authentication/representation/cookie and Connection-nominated trailer names rejected; unknown trailers remain untrusted application metadata
Zero limit fields select defaults; body decoding does not decompress content
Body writing, informational response orchestration, TCP/TLS clients, URLs, redirects, pooling and mobile/macOS-x64 acceptance remain pending
No fuzzer/sanitizer, exhaustive allocation-fault, public compiler/SDK, independent CI or release claim
Local Git repository remains uncommitted; parent gitlink and assigned public origin remain pending
compiler_fix: Native selected variant-arm ownership correction; public SDK compilers remain affected
